<!-- Generated by tools/refgen from spin-terraform-aws:images.json. Edit the source, not this file. -->

Every machine of an installation boots Spin OS, built for one release of spin. The module reads the image of each machine from its `images.json`, by `spin_version` and region, so an installation of `v20261019.02` can be made in a region listed here and nowhere else. To boot images of your own, name them with `image_ids` and their measurements with `image_measurements` ([the module's variables](/reference/terraform/root/#image_ids)).

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-0dc9ac38b49de8d33` | `ami-00f3f3b5733281305` | `ami-0bd146ffda6b24636` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-06e684cd6f90c11fb` | `ami-0a066cfde3dac4085` | `ami-06cc71ed19ee1a754` |
